name: china-visa-free-data
title: China visa-free entry policies by country
description: Unilateral visa-free entry, mutual visa exemptions and 240-hour visa-free transit for travellers to mainland China, one record per country.

sources.title: Notice on the Extension of the Unilateral Visa-Free Policy
Notice Regarding the Implementation of Visa-Free Policies for Canada and the United Kingdom
China extends visa-free policy for Russia to Dec 31, 2027

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name in English, as used on chinaeasymode.com.

fields.name: iso2
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL slug of the country page on chinaeasymode.com.

fields.name: entry_policy
fields.description: Best visa-free entry route for an ordinary visit: `unilateral_visa_free`, `mutual_visa_exemption`, `transit_240h_only` (no visa-free entry, but 240-hour transit applies) or `visa_required`.

fields.name: visa_free_days
fields.description: Maximum stay per entry under the entry policy. Empty when no visa-free entry applies.

fields.name: unilateral_days
fields.description: Days allowed under China's unilateral visa-free policy. Empty if the country is not covered.

fields.name: unilateral_until
fields.description: Last day of the unilateral policy (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty when the country is not covered, or when the source data gives no end date.

fields.name: mutual_days
fields.description: Days per stay under a mutual visa exemption agreement. Empty if none.

fields.name: transit_240h
fields.description: `true` if nationals qualify for 240-hour (10-day) visa-free transit.

fields.name: note_label
fields.description: Short heading of a country-specific note, if any.

fields.name: note_text
fields.description: Country-specific note, if any.

fields.name: note_url
fields.description: Link backing the note.

fields.name: unilateral_source
fields.description: Official source for the unilateral policy for this country.

fields.name: mutual_source
fields.description: Official source for the mutual exemption for this country.

fields.name: transit_240h_source
fields.description: Official source for 240-hour transit eligibility for this country.

fields.name: source_status
fields.description: `official` (every policy on the row has an official source), `missing_official_source` (at least one has none yet, see `missing_sources`) or `no_policy_claimed`.

fields.name: missing_sources
fields.description: Policies on the row that still lack an official source, separated by `;`.

fields.name: verified_on
fields.description: Date China Easy Mode last verified the upstream data.

fields.name: embassy_url
fields.description: Chinese embassy in that country.

fields.name: guide_url
fields.description: China Easy Mode guide for travellers from that country.
